name: fal.ai
description: Search and run fal.ai models (image, video, speech, music, transcription) with your own fal key. Outputs are saved to the library.

models.title: Model tools
models.description: Comma-separated fal endpoint ids that get their own typed tool (for example fal-ai/flux/dev). Leave empty for none.

cache_ttl_hours.title: Catalog cache (hours)
cache_ttl_hours.description: How long model search results and schemas are cached on disk.

max_wait_minutes.title: Max wait (minutes)
max_wait_minutes.description: After this long the call stops waiting and asks the provider to cancel the job; the error says whether the cancel was accepted and how to collect the job later.

allow_url_inputs.title: Allow URL file inputs
allow_url_inputs.description: Let model file inputs be https URLs. The provider fetches them, so anything in the link is shared with it. Off: library artifacts only ("artifact:<id>").
